TaxMate UAE Compliance module: tracks UBO (beneficial ownership) register changes and Economic Substance Regulations (ESR) notification/report filings.

This module keeps a record for reminders and audit trail -- it does NOT submit anything to the Ministry of Economy, a Free Zone Authority, or the UBO registrar on your behalf. File through your regulatory authority's own portal, then record the filing here.

Deadlines above are configurable defaults; UBO reporting windows and ESR notification/report deadlines can vary by regulatory authority -- confirm the exact figures that apply to each company.
